name: Lunar Abyss Manta Deep
introDiscord: Moonlit Reef drops away into blackwater so deep the light bends before reaching the bottom. Vast Manta silhouettes glide through the darkness, visible only when their markings briefly resemble distant moons.
introTwitch: Moonlit Reef drops away into blackwater so deep the light bends before reaching the bottom. Vast Manta silhouettes glide through the darkness, visible only when their markings briefly resemble distant moons.

duskfall-shelf.prompt: The duskfall shelf ends where three routes descend into immeasurable blackwater. Pale crescents drift beyond the last moonlight, far too large to be stars.

left.message: A pale crescent appears in the darkness. Then a second. They move together. You realize they are markings on the wings of something enormous coming closer.

right.message: A moon-shell coffer rests at the very edge of the shelf. You recover Star Candies while carefully refusing to look directly down.

forward.message: Shizuki's Abyssmint tonic reads: "Even darkness needs emergency supplies. Also: do not drop bottle. We are NOT going after it."
forward.fullHpMessage: The Abyssmint tonic remains secured at the shelf. You are already at full health, and nobody needs to retrieve a dropped bottle from below.

abyssal-gallery.prompt: Faint mineral lines trace three paths through the blackwater. Beyond their glow, the Deep appears infinite.

left.message: A Fae offering vessel floats just outside the mineral light. Retrieving Star Candies requires exactly enough darkness to make you regret the decision.

right.message: One Berry is tied to Shizuki's old depth marker. Her note reads: "Could not see bottom. Decided bottom did not require my supervision."

forward.message: An enormous shadow glides beneath the path. For several seconds nothing happens. Then a Lunar Abyss Manta rises silently from below.

moonless-span.prompt: Stone pillars cross a stretch of absolute blackwater. Three currents descend between them while distant points of light move in ways stars should not.

left.message: Shizuki's bottle reads: "Drink slowly. The Deep notices sudden confidence. Probably. I wasn't willing to test it."
left.fullHpMessage: Shizuki's confidence-sensitive remedy remains sealed. At full health, you can continue moving slowly enough not to attract the Deep's attention.

right.message: Two glowing eyes appear beyond the pillar. They are far apart. Much farther apart than you would prefer.

forward.message: A Moonkeeper cache has been chained to the stone so it cannot sink farther. Inside are Star Candies and a very sensible amount of rope.

boss-antechamber.name: Moonwing Blackwater
boss-antechamber.prompt: Stone pillars vanish into the Moonwing blackwater around a current with no visible floor. Distant moon-shaped lights circle beneath the span.

bossPromptDiscord:
The distant lights vanish.

Something enormous passes beneath every pillar at once.

A pair of moon-shaped markings slowly rises from the blackwater.

Use /yes to remain on the Span or /no to return to somewhere with a visible floor.
bossPromptTwitch:
The distant lights vanish.

Something enormous passes beneath every pillar at once.

A pair of moon-shaped markings slowly rises from the blackwater.

Use !yes to remain on the Span or !no to return to somewhere with a visible floor.
bossRetreatText: You return toward visible stone. The moon-shaped markings sink into the blackwater, and distant lights slowly reappear.

boss.revealText: An immense Manta rises from the abyss, moonlight flowing across its wings. The Abyssal Moonwing fills the blackwater!

completionText: The Abyssal Moonwing dives back into the Deep until its glow becomes another distant star. A current opens ahead. You decide not to find out how far down it went.
